chapters.title: First Impressions
chapters.description: Let's break the ice and see what you noticed.

questions.text: What was the very first thing you noticed about me?
What's a weird first impression you often give people?
What's the best compliment you've ever received?
If you had to describe my vibe in three words right now, what would they be?

mission.text: Take a moment. No phones for the next three minutes. Just be here.

questions.text: What's a topic you could talk about for hours without stopping?
What's something you're secretly really proud of but rarely talk about?
What's a small thing that instantly ruins a date for you?
If you could instantly master any skill tonight, what would it be?

mission.text: Choose the next song to play. Make it a good one.

questions.text: What is the most chaotic thing you've done on a whim?
What's a popular opinion you completely disagree with?
If you had to fake your own death, how would you do it?
What's the worst advice you've ever actually followed?

mission.text: Take one selfie together to document this exact moment.

chapters.title: Chemistry
chapters.description: Let's see if we're actually on the same page.

questions.text: What's something you find undeniably attractive in a person?
Do you believe chemistry is instant, or built over time?
What's the most romantic thing someone has unexpectedly done for you?
If you could freeze this moment, what would you remember most about it?

mission.text: Maintain eye contact for 30 seconds. No talking.

chapters.title: Future
chapters.description: Looking ahead, whatever that might mean.

questions.text: What are you most looking forward to in the next month?
Where is somewhere you've always wanted to travel but haven't yet?
What's a goal you're currently working towards that excites you?
If tonight was a movie, what would the ending scene look like?

mission.text: Just enjoy the moment in silence. Let it sink in.
